entries.cause: A heavily damaged raider that survives a tactical RAIDER_INTERCEPTION battle is now scuttled or interned using scuttleThresholdBp and scuttleShareBp; in this scenario the Austro-Hungarian raider was already at 19 percent hull from a month 1 fleet battle, so it is scuttled after the month 3 interception, adding one RaiderEngaged event
entries.migrationAssessment: Replay only, no save state or schema change: ledgers gain a RaiderEngaged event and a trade disposition draw only when a tactical raider battle leaves a survivor under scuttleThresholdBp; saves and rulesets without the raiderInterception block are unaffected
